description:
Job Family : 
SAAS/PAAS/Cloud Application Development 
 Travel Required : 
None 
 Clearance Required : 
None 
 
 What You Will Do: 
 Guidehouse has an exciting opportunity for MuleSoft Developers in a high-growth practice. You will be a key contributor on the consulting team that designs, develops, and implements innovative integration and API solutions using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. You will help ensure successful client engagements, technical delivery, and implementation of scalable and secure enterprise integrations.
 
 You will work closely with the Solution Architect, Technical Architect, business analysts, client stakeholders, and other members of the delivery team. This role requires a strong foundation in MuleSoft development, API-led connectivity, enterprise integration patterns, DataWeave, and the design and implementation of real-time and batch integrations.
 
 What You Will Need: 
 Bachelor's degree and a MINIMUM of FOUR (4) years of experience in enterprise application integration, including hands-on MuleSoft development experience using Mule 4 and the Anypoint Platform; OR TEN (10) years of relevant experience may be substituted for formal education or an advanced degree

 Selected candidate must be able to commute to the Guidehouse San Antonio, TX office up to 5x/week

 ​US Citizenship is contractually required

 Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting MuleSoft APIs and integrations

 Strong experience with Mule 4, Anypoint Studio, DataWeave 2.0, APIKit, Exchange, API Manager, and Runtime Manager

 Experience implementing API-led connectivity using Experience, Process, and System APIs

 Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, RAML, OpenAPI, JSON, XML, XSD, and YAML

 Experience building real-time, event-driven, scheduled, and batch integrations across cloud, SaaS, legacy, database, and on-premises systems

 Strong DataWeave skills and experience with reusable error handling, logging, shared components, and common MuleSoft connectors

 Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, asynchronous messaging, routing, transformation, and orchestration

 Experience implementing API security using OAuth 2.0, Client ID Enforcement, JWT, SSL/TLS, mutual TLS, and certificates

 Experience deploying MuleSoft applications to CloudHub, CloudHub 2.0, Runtime Fabric, or on-premises environments

 Experience with Git, Maven, CI/CD tools, and automated testing using MUnit

 Experience monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting MuleSoft applications using Anypoint Monitoring, Runtime Manager, logs, and observability tools

 Understanding of API lifecycle management, governance, versioning, security, scalability, and integration best practices

 Ability to participate in technical design, code reviews, deployments, defect resolution, and production support

 Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical teams, business stakeholders, and client leadership

 Up to 10% travel may be required for this position

 
 What Would Be Nice To Have: 
 Experience in a “Big 4” or equivalent established consulting firm and/or MuleSoft implementation partner is highly desired

 BA/BS degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field

 MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 1 certification is preferred

 MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 2, MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect, or MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect certification is highly desired

 Experience with Federal Government, Department of Defense, or public-sector clients preferred

 Experience delivering solutions in environments subject to federal security, compliance, and documentation requirements

 Experience with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Hybrid-Agile delivery methodologies

 Experience with MuleSoft Runtime Fabric and container-based deployments

 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, or other container orchestration platforms

 Experience with Azure API Management, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, Kong, or other API management platforms

 Experience integrating MuleSoft with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Health Cloud, or other Salesforce products

 Strong hands-on experience with Mule 4, Anypoint Studio, DataWeave 2.0, APIKit, Anypoint Exchange, Runtime Manager, and API Manager

 Experience designing and implementing Experience APIs, Process APIs, and System APIs using API-led connectivity principles

 Expert-level experience designing and developing RESTful and SOAP-based web services

 Experience developing API specifications using RAML, OpenAPI, JSON, XML, XSD, and YAML

 Experience integrating MuleSoft with Salesforce, databases, legacy applications, SaaS platforms, third-party applications, and external web services

 Experience implementing reusable error-handling frameworks, logging standards, common services, and shared integration components

 Experience with MuleSoft connectors, including HTTP, Database, File, SFTP, Salesforce, JMS, Web Service Consumer, and other enterprise connectors

 Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including routing, transformation, orchestration, publish-subscribe, request-response, and asynchronous messaging

 Experience deploying and managing MuleSoft applications in CloudHub, CloudHub 2.0, Runtime Fabric, or on-premises Mule runtime environments

 Experience with source control and automated build and deployment processes using Git, Maven, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD tools

 Experience troubleshooting application, connectivity, performance, and production-support issues using Anypoint Monitoring, Runtime Manager, logs, and enterprise observability tools

 








 
 
 
 What We Offer: 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Parental Leave

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Group Term Life and Travel Assistance

 Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance

 Health Savings Account, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Transit and Parking Commuter Benefits

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development, Certifications & Learning Opportunities

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Care.com annual membership

 Employee Assistance Program

 Supplemental Benefits via Corestream (Critical Care, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Legal Assistance and ID theft protection, etc.)

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

 
 About Guidehouse 
 Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer–Protected Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.
 
 Guidehouse will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law or ordinance including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco.
 
 If you have visited our website for information about employment opportunities, or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Guidehouse Recruiting at 1-571-633-1711 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@guidehouse.com . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.
 
 All communication regarding recruitment for a Guidehouse position will be sent from Guidehouse email domains including @guidehouse.com or guidehouse@myworkday.com .  Correspondence received by an applicant from any other domain should be considered unauthorized and will not be honored by Guidehouse.  Note that Guidehouse will never charge a fee or require a money transfer at any stage of the recruitment process and does not collect fees from educational institutions for participation in a recruitment event. Never provide your banking information to a third party purporting to need that information to proceed in the hiring process.
 
 If any person or organization demands money related to a job opportunity with Guidehouse, please report the matter to Guidehouse’s Ethics Hotline. If you want to check the validity of correspondence you have received, please contact recruiting@guidehouse.com . Guidehouse is not responsible for losses incurred (monetary or otherwise) from an applicant’s dealings with unauthorized third parties.
 
 Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.
